subject: lentil eaters?
author: Aaboe
body:
Nah, we went to a normal shop on the day after and got it while being nice and warm and looking at other games. No rush, no long waiting, just nice and quiet.

And he's quite the carnivore and only hugs trees when trying to keep the dog from running away with him 😛

I will accept... when next I actually play Paradise 😃

Laters...

Aaboe

body:

subject: not the movie
author: Aaboe
body:
It isn't the movie, but the game. When I bought my second eggbox, I got a bundle with it, in this case Lego Indy and Kung Fu Panda.

But at some stage I *will* see the movie. Sounds and looks like it's right up my alley.

Aaboe
